methodology: Read official city, park-district, NPS, public utility recreation and official venue sources through web browsing. Each source explicitly distinguishes a direct page read from official search-index text.
Resource links serve as official navigation entry points; a link alone is not evidence that its full contents or every current program was re-audited.
No unconfirmed exact fares, live spaces, transit headways, parking availability or projected facility opening dates are presented as certain.
Nearby identifies a visitor extension outside the compact city itinerary; place scope is not derived from a postal address. Unresolved park parcel boundaries are not asserted as proven.
Current-specific alerts are explicitly dated in visitor content. Source ledger is factual paraphrase, not copied page text.
